method.name: numpy.random.default_rng(PCG64); two correlated standard normals followed by inverse-CDF triangular and beta transforms; two independent inverse-CDF triangular drivers
method.acceptance: Retain finite draws inside declared inclusive bounds and with WACC > terminal_growth; reject all others; report rejected raw draws separately.
method.sequence: One MAX_DRAWS x 2 standard-normal matrix is transformed by a Gaussian copula; then two independent uniform vectors are drawn. Only the first N_VALID legal rows are used.
method.fy1_scope: Residual H2 only: prior-year H2 = FY0 revenue - prior-year H1 revenue. FY2-FY5 compound the sampled growth on FY1 residual revenue as required by the path convention.
method.revenue_rule: Revenue(t)=Revenue(t-1)*(1+sampled revenue_growth), with Revenue(0)=prior-year H2; growth is constant within each path.
method.ebit_rule: EBIT(t)=Revenue(t)*sampled ebit_margin; margin is constant within each path.
method.reinvestment_rule: Reinvestment(t)=Revenue(t)*sampled reinvestment_intensity = CapEx + increase in NWC - D&A; positive consumes cash.
method.fcff_rule: FCFF=EBIT*(1-tax_rate)-reinvestment. Stock compensation remains in operating costs and is never added back.
method.equity_bridge: Enterprise value + 8655 cash and short-term investments - 13904 noncurrent debt, divided by 461.8 diluted shares. Current debt is unavailable (null), not observed as zero; the net-debt proxy is a limitation.
method.full_year_fy1_output_reconciliation: Simulation trajectory FY1 is H2 only. Model Outputs FY1 revenue/EBIT/EPS additionally include reported H1 actuals exactly once; simulation values are not discounted a second time.
method.units: USD millions except value_per_share in USD; rates decimals; shares millions

revenue_growth.unit: decimal annual revenue growth; FY1 applies to prior-year H2

reinvestment_intensity.unit: decimal of trajectory revenue; positive consumes cash

dependence.copula_correlation_note: 0.35 is the latent normal correlation for growth and margin; rank/marginal transformation means realized Pearson correlation need not equal 0.35. Other pairs are generated independently.
dependence.rationale: Positive growth-margin dependence reflects scale, fixed-cost absorption and fewer emergency markdowns in stronger demand; independence of the other pairs is a parsimonious limitation, not evidence of no economic dependence.

realized_correlation.measure: Pearson correlation across the 10000 retained paths

percentile_convention: Sort values ascending; zero-based position (N-1)*q; linear interpolation between floor and ceil ranks. p50 is the median.
limitations: Open assumptions are analyst scenarios conditioned on the frozen 2025-09-16 information set, not observed market prices or consensus.
The four drivers are held constant within each path; the path FY2-FY5 growth chain starts from residual FY1 H2 and therefore is not a full-year base-case reconciliation.
The triangular and beta bounds are explicit stress assumptions informed by historical volatility, not confidence intervals estimated from a complete quarterly panel.
Only growth and margin are dependent. Reinvestment and discount-rate shocks are independent by construction; macro co-movement and parameter uncertainty are omitted.
Terminal growth is fixed at 0.02 and WACC is bounded above it, so terminal-value uncertainty is incomplete and terminal value remains material.

Current debt, FY1 H2 actual cash flow, comparable sales, traffic and ticket are unavailable or null in the frozen source; null is not treated as an observed zero, and operating narratives are not quantified as facts.
Equity bridge uses FY0 noncurrent debt and FY0 cash plus short-term investments; latest-quarter debt and investments are unavailable. This is a proxy, not a current market capital structure.
The distribution is a conditional DCF sensitivity distribution, not a stock-price forecast or a statement about future realized returns.
